actions.add_bot_to_live_meeting.descript: Sends the Fireflies bot (Fred) to a meeting that is happening now.
actions.add_bot_to_live_meeting.props.du: How long the bot stays, 15 to 120 minutes. Default 60.
actions.add_bot_to_live_meeting.props.la: Optional meeting language code, for example "en" or "es".
actions.add_bot_to_live_meeting.props.me: The https:// join link of the live meeting.
actions.ask_fred.description: Asks Fireflies AI (AskFred) a question about one meeting or a set of meetings.
actions.ask_fred.props.from_date.descrip: Only meetings on or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time (at most 1 year back).
actions.ask_fred.props.meeting_id.descri: Ask about this one meeting. Leave empty to use the filters below instead.
actions.ask_fred.props.query.description: The question to ask, up to 2000 characters.
actions.ask_fred.props.response_language: Optional language code for the answer, for example "en" or "es".
actions.ask_fred.props.to_date.descripti: Only meetings on or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.
actions.create_soundbite.description: Creates a soundbite (clip) from part of a meeting.
Where the clip ends, in seconds. Must be after the start.
actions.create_soundbite.props.meeting_i: The Fireflies meeting ID to clip.
actions.create_soundbite.props.privacies: Who can see the clip. Leave empty for the Fireflies default.
actions.create_soundbite.props.start_tim: Where the clip starts, in seconds from the start of the meeting.
actions.create_soundbite.props.summary.d: Optional description of the clip, up to 500 characters.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a request to the Fireflies API, e.g. POST /graphql with a GraphQL query. The API key is added for you.
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_meeting.description: Permanently deletes a meeting and its transcript.
The Fireflies meeting ID to delete.
actions.find-meeting-by-id.description: Finds a specific meeting by ID.
actions.find-meeting-by-id.props.meeting: The ID of the meeting to retrieve.
actions.find_meeting_by_query.descriptio: Searches meetings based on provided parameters. Returns up to 1,000 meetings; narrow the filters if more match.
actions.find_meeting_by_query.props.date: Finds meetings in the 24 hours starting at this date and time. Pick the date in the date picker to get that day in your time zone.
actions.find_meeting_by_query.props.titl: Finds meetings whose title contains this text.
actions.find_recent_meeting.description: Retrieves the latest meeting for a user.
actions.get_current_user.description: Gets the Fireflies user who owns the API key.
actions.get_meeting.description: Gets the details of one meeting, without its summary or transcript.
actions.get_meeting.props.meeting_id.des: The Fireflies meeting ID, for example from Find Meetings.
actions.get_meeting_summary.description: Gets the AI summary of one meeting.
actions.get_meeting_summary.props.meetin: The Fireflies meeting ID, for example from Find Meetings.
actions.get_meeting_transcript.descripti: Gets the spoken sentences of one meeting, a page at a time.
actions.get_meeting_transcript.props.mee: The Fireflies meeting ID, for example from Find Meetings.
actions.get_meeting_transcript.props.off: Number of sentences to skip. Default 0. Use next_offset from the previous call.
actions.list_channels.description: Lists the Fireflies channels the user can see.
actions.list_contacts.description: Lists the people the user has had meetings with.
actions.list_contacts.props.offset.descr: Contacts to skip. Default 0. Use next_offset from the previous call.
actions.list_users.description: Lists the users on the Fireflies team.
actions.move_meetings_to_channel.descrip: Moves up to 5 meetings into a channel.
actions.move_meetings_to_channel.props.c: The destination channel ID, from List Channels.
actions.move_meetings_to_channel.props.m: 1 to 5 Fireflies meeting IDs to move.
actions.revoke_meeting_access.descriptio: Removes shared access to a meeting for one email address.
actions.search_meetings.description: Searches Fireflies meetings and returns one page of short results.
actions.search_meetings.props.channel_id: Only meetings in this channel (from List Channels).
Only meetings on or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time, for example 2026-03-01 or 2026-03-01T09:00:00Z. Times without an offset are UTC.
actions.search_meetings.props.keyword.de: Text to look for (max 255 characters). Where to look is set by Search In.
actions.search_meetings.props.mine.descr: Choose "Yes" to return only meetings owned by the API key owner.
actions.search_meetings.props.organizers: Only meetings organized by any of these email addresses.
actions.search_meetings.props.participan: Only meetings that any of these email addresses attended.
actions.search_meetings.props.scope.desc: Where the keyword is matched: the meeting title (default), the spoken sentences, or both.
actions.search_meetings.props.skip.descr: How many matching meetings to skip, for paging. Default 0.
actions.search_meetings.props.to_date.de: Only meetings on or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time. A date alone includes the whole day (UTC).
actions.search_meetings.props.user_id.de: Only meetings owned by this Fireflies user ID (from Get Current User or List Users).
actions.share_meeting.description: Shares a meeting with people by email.
actions.share_meeting.props.emails.descr: 1 to 50 email addresses to share with.
Optional. Days until the shared access expires. Leave empty for no expiry.
actions.share_meeting.props.meeting_id.d: The Fireflies meeting ID to share.
actions.update_meeting_privacy.descripti: Changes who can see a meeting.
actions.update_meeting_title.props.meeti: The Fireflies meeting ID to rename.
actions.update_meeting_title.props.title: 5 to 256 characters.
New Title
actions.upload_audio.description: Creates a new meeting in Fireflies for transcription (requires a publicly accessible URL).
actions.upload_audio.props.audioUrl.desc: The publicly accessible HTTPS URL of your audio or video file (mp3, mp4, wav, m4a, ogg). Fireflies only accepts URLs, not direct file uploads. For private files, use a signed URL with a short expiry.
actions.upload_audio.props.bypass_size_c: Optional. Choose "Yes" to upload files under 50 KB, which Fireflies otherwise rejects.
actions.upload_audio.props.client_refere: Optional. Your own ID for this upload. Fireflies echoes it back in its webhooks.
actions.upload_audio.props.custom_langua: Optional. Language of the recording as a code such as "es" or "de". Leave empty for English.
Optional. When the meeting happened, as ISO 8601 (for example 2026-03-15 or 2026-03-15T14:30:00Z). Cannot be in the future.
auth.description:
To use Fireflies.ai, you need an API key:
1. Log in to your account at https://app.fireflies.ai.
2. Open **Integrations** and click **Fireflies API**.
3. Copy your API key and paste it here.
description: Meeting assistant that automatically records, transcribes, and analyzes conversations
triggers.meeting_summarized.description: Triggered when Fireflies finishes the AI summary of a meeting. A resend from Fireflies after notes change fires again, and in rare cases a delivery may fire twice.
triggers.meeting_summarized.props.signin: Optional. The secret you set on the Fireflies Webhooks V2 page. When set, deliveries without a matching X-Hub-Signature are ignored.
triggers.meeting_summarized.props.webhoo:
## Fireflies.ai Webhook Setup

Fireflies has no API for creating webhooks, so add this one by hand:

1. In Fireflies, open **Settings** > **Developer settings** > **Webhooks V2**.
2. Add a webhook with this URL:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
3. Tick the **meeting.summarized** event.
4. Optional but recommended: set a signing secret in Fireflies and paste the same value into **Signing Secret** below.
5. Save, then publish this flow.

Webhooks V2 only cover meetings owned by the Fireflies user who adds the webhook. Team-wide webhooks need an Enterprise plan and a Super Admin.

Webhooks that were set up in the old Developer settings webhook field (V1) keep working with this trigger.
triggers.new_transcription_completed.des: Triggered when a new meeting is transcribed. The summary may still be processing at this point; use Meeting Summarized if you need it. A resend from Fireflies after notes change fires again, and in rare cases a delivery may fire twice.
triggers.new_transcription_completed.pro: Optional. The secret you set on the Fireflies Webhooks V2 page. When set, deliveries without a matching X-Hub-Signature are ignored.
